title: Fair Play in the Newsroom: Actor-Based Filtering Gender Discrimination in Text Corpora

bias_targets.methodology: Actor-level discourse analysis using Named Entity Recognition (NER) and coreference resolution to extract male- and female-coded actors. The methodology evaluates gender representation by computing metrics for syntactic roles (subject vs. object position to measure agency), quotation styles (direct vs. indirect speech to measure discursive authority), naming vs. pronoun reference ratios, sentiment analysis, and Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) for lexical associations.
